title: A Critical Pragmatism Approach for Algorithmic Fairness: Lessons from Urban Planning Theory
reasoning: The paper is centered on the intersection of ethical frameworks and algorithmic fairness. It draws extensively from philosophical pragmatism, epistemology, and 'critical pragmatism' to address the value-laden and moral challenges inherent in designing fair algorithms. It specifically discusses moral dimensions such as 'morally thick' practice stories and 'hermeneutic praxis.'
